instructions: DO NOT MODIFY THIS FILE.  This file may be replaced at anytime without notice in your source code repository.
This file is part of the standard development framework at Alight. If you have suggested changes, please
see this page for how to contribute to the Alight Development Paved Paths: https://alightarchitecture.atlassian.net/wiki/x/AYC6GQ

questions.name: change_type

choices.name: feat:      Bump MINOR in SemVer. A new feature.
fix:       Bump PATCH in SemVer. A bug fix.
perf:      Bump PATCH in SemVer. A code change that improves performance.
refactor:  Bump PATCH in SemVer. A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature.
build:     No effect on SemVer. Changes to build system or dependencies (eg: docker, pip, npm).
test:      No effect on SemVer. Adding or changing tests.
ci:        No effect on SemVer. Changes to CI files and scripts (eg: GitHub Workflows).
style:     No effect on SemVer. Changes that do not affect code execution (eg: white-space, formatting, semi-colons, etc).
docs:      No effect on SemVer. Documentation only changes.

questions.message: Select the type of change you are committing

questions.name: scope
questions.message: What is the scope of this change? (class or file name): (press [enter] to skip)

questions.name: message
questions.message: Write a short and imperative summary of the code changes: (lower case and no period)

questions.name: add_info
questions.message: Provide additional contextual information about the code changes: (press [enter] to skip)

questions.name: is_breaking_change
questions.message: Is this a BREAKING CHANGE? Correlates with MAJOR in SemVer

questions.name: footer
questions.message: Provide additional detail on the BREAKING CHANGE: (press [enter] to skip if this is not a BREAKING CHANGE)

questions.name: jira_ids
questions.message: Provide a comma delimited list of JIRA IDs (ex. DX-382,DX-475) that are addressed with this change
